title: UPI TF1766→2026 Constitutional Axis
purpose: Versioned model for tracing a constitutional principle across historical nodes while evaluating a norm against the law applicable at the relevant date.
current_law_rule: Use the latest legally effective consolidated text for the relevant date; older versions remain historical and must not be substituted for current law.
legal_test_guard: A non-zero mathematical residual is a flag for legal-source review; it is not itself a legal conclusion.

classification_guards.HIST: Historical text/version, not applicable current law unless the question is historical.
classification_guards.EST_CURRENT: Current legally effective text for the specified date.
classification_guards.EST_SOURCE: Relevant continuing source material such as preparatory works; not itself statutory text.
classification_guards.HYP: Unverified proposition that must be tested against exact sources.
classification_guards.SYM: Formal/model representation, not a claim that the model is itself law.

legal_scope_guard: The model does not infer that an EU rule is censorship. It tests the exact provision, obligation, actor, time, action, publication timing, medium, applicable TF/YGL text, RF provisions, and relevant source material.
notes: TF 1949:105 and RF 1974:152 remain the SFS identities of the constitutions, but their original enactment texts are historical versions; current consolidated text is selected by effective date.
KU21 is retained as relevant constitutional preparatory/source material rather than as statutory text.
TF1766 is the historical anchor of the model, not current law.
